newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan bank shares higher on hopes for land market.
newsitem.headline: Japan bank shares higher on hopes for land market.

text.p: Japanese bank issues were firmer on Monday morning, supported by a newspaper report of a government plan to securitise collateralised land in order to boost liquidity in the property market, traders said.
At 0115 GMT, the banking sector was ranked as the third largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
By 0128 GMT, Sakura Bank Ltd had gained 19 yen to 804 in heavy trade. Its turnover of 3.984 million shares was the second largest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

"The banking sector attracted buying because of the (reported) measures to securitise collateralised land. Sakura, which is the benchmark in the sector, particularly benefited," said a broker at a medium-sized securities house.
Shares of Sanwa Bank Ltd jumped 80 yen to 1,480, after being bid-only at the opening. The bank was the seventh largest percentage gainer on the first section.
